wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws=wb['Sheet1']

    f='=IF(AND(A{r}="",B{r}=""),"",IF(B{r}<TIME(0,30,0),B{r}+TIME(24,0,0)-TIME(0,30,0),B{r}-TIME(0,30,0)))'.format(r=r)
    ws.cell(row=r,column=3).value=f
wb.save(out)
print('done')
